story: Dense scene, three objects block CLOSE_DISHWASHER: the skillet handle (door), a 0.20 m water bottle (right bay) and a 0.25 m bottle (left bay) (tub ceiling). The cereal box on the counter stands in the transfer corridors of BOTH bottles; the tall bottle also stands under the skillet's handle-across pose and in its swing. Minimal recourse: box -> water bottle -> tall bottle -> skillet (or the skillet turned right once the water bottle is gone).
